description: This PHP script handles the process of checking the status of a configuration export, retrieving a backup configuration file, and serving it as a download to the client. It includes license info, executes system commands to interact with configuration management, and manages file I/O for downloading.

methods.name: switch
methods.description: Evaluates system status codes and outputs corresponding messages or proceeds with backup download logic.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes system commands to check status, get configuration data, and retrieve command outputs.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses script execution, used while polling for update completion.

methods.name: filesize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a specified file (backup configuration).

methods.name: header
methods.description: Sends HTTP headers to initiate file download to client.

methods.name: fopen
methods.description: Opens a file handle for reading the backup configuration file.

methods.name: fread
methods.description: Reads data from an open file handle in chunks for output.

methods.name: fclose
methods.description: Closes an open file handle after reading completes.
